integrity: The proof derives the projective bijection from the exact adjoint equation \(y^{15}=\rho\), uses nondegeneracy of the relative trace form to identify \(C_\rho=y^\perp\), and eliminates \(y\) from the trace-zero condition. A standalone exhaustive finite-field verifier independently checks all \(21\) singular images, all hyperplanes, all hulls, and the five polynomial roots.
scientific_limitations: The result refines the finite \(q=4\), \(m=3\), \(k=1\) worked example. The source already establishes the numerical \(60/5\) LCD/non-LCD count; the contribution here is the projective-hyperplane bijection and the representation-independent exceptional equation \(\rho^5+\rho^4+1=0\). No generalization to arbitrary Frobenius parameters is claimed.
title: Example 6.15 runs through every hyperplane, with a five-root non-LCD locus
